provenance_standards.cavity_architecture_reference: Paik et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 107, 240501 (2011); Reagor et al., Phys. Rev. B 94, 014506 (2016)
provenance_standards.fluxoid_mesoscopic_reference: Landauer, IBM J. Res. Dev. 1, 223 (1957); Buttiker, Phys. Rev. Lett. 57, 1761 (1986)

experiments.title: Cryogenic Superconducting Niobium 3D Cavity Impedance Transmission Test

hardware_substrate.perturbation_mechanism: High-purity sapphire dielectric pin (epsilon_r = 11.5, diameter = 1.0 mm, variable axial/angular displacement)

experiments.hypothesis: H1: The prefactor 1/2 in Z_0/(2*R_K) generates an anomalous physical boundary phase pull Delta_phi = (1/2)*(Z_0/R_K) manifesting as an anisotropic cavity frequency shift delta_f.
experiments.null_hypothesis: H0: Transmission across cavity boundaries obeys standard Maxwell-Fresnel boundary conditions with zero anomalous prefactor shift (Delta_phi = 0).
experiments.baseline: Standard Maxwell-Fresnel boundary eigenmode calculations in high-purity Nb cavity.
experiments.expected_observable: Anomalous resonant frequency shift delta_f / f_0 as a function of perturbation angle theta.

controls.negative_control: Impedance-matched 50-Ohm cryogenic coaxial transmission line (zero resonant cavity).
controls.positive_control: Symmetric Fabry-Perot cavity with calibrated sapphire dielectric translation.

experiments.falsification_criterion: If measured anomalous frequency shift |delta_f_anom| <= 3.0 * sigma_Hz (<= 1.5 Hz, or delta_f/f_0 <= 3.0e-10), H1 is ruled out and the physical field-pair interpretation is formally REFUTED.

experiments.title: Hybrid Normal-Superconducting Ring Aharonov-Bohm Phase Slip

hardware_substrate.ring_materials: Bimetallic Al (superconducting, Tc = 1.2 K) / Cu (normal) lithographic ring

experiments.hypothesis: H1: The pairing factor (1/2)^n produces intermediate fractional fluxoid conductance oscillations at (1/4)*Phi_0 in hybrid ring geometries.
experiments.null_hypothesis: H0: Fluxoid quantization transitions strictly between h/e and h/2e according to BCS pairing order parameter Psi with zero fractional intermediate states.
experiments.baseline: Mesoscopic Landauer-Buttiker conductance oscillations under external magnetic flux.
experiments.expected_observable: Fourier amplitude of magnetoconductance at flux frequencies f = 1/Phi_0 and f = 2/Phi_0.

controls.positive_control: Continuous aluminum superconducting ring (pure h/2e period).

experiments.falsification_criterion: If Fourier spectrum exhibits zero amplitude at 4/Phi_0 (fractional prefactor) within 3-sigma noise floor, H1 is formally REFUTED.
